name: LED 5 mm (T-1 3/4)
source: Typical 5 mm through-hole LED datasheet (5.8 mm flange, 8.6 mm tall, 2.54 mm lead pitch); legs assumed trimmed to 10 mm; not yet measured
notes: Anode is the longer leg; the cathode is on the flat side of the flange. A 5 mm lid hole holds the lens and the 5.8 mm flange stops it from pushing through. Needs a 220 ohm series resistor on the anode.
